name: Indiana Wire Assemblies
old_description: EMF Corporation is an experienced manufacturer of custom wire harnesses, custom injection-molded connectors, fluorescent lamp holders, electric motor leads, and more for customers nationwide and throughout North America since 1970, with manufacturing locations in Indiana, Kentucky, and Mississippi.
about:
EMF Corporation was established in 1970 in Angola, Indiana, and operates four manufacturing facilities across Indiana, Kentucky, and Mississippi. The company serves customers nationwide and throughout North America from its Midwestern and Southern U.S. locations.

The company produces custom wire harnesses, discrete wire harnesses, injection-molded connectors, fluorescent lamp holders, lead wires, electronic cables, specialty connectors, receptacles, and junctions. Its capabilities include precision injection molding, custom electrical system engineering, prototyping, tooling, and full production runs. A sizable catalog of standard components supports custom assembly work, and the firm also manufactures electrical box builds, DC barrel connectors, extension cords, and shelf light harnesses.

EMF serves industries including retail, manufacturing, vending, refrigeration, lighting, electric motors, electrical controls, HVAC, automotive, and appliances. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to end-users across North America seeking custom electrical wiring systems and molded connectors.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement programs consistent with ISO standards, and most products carry UL and CSA recognition. Management describes a turnkey approach from engineering through production, with a willingness to tackle unusual or challenging projects without restrictions on size, type, or scope.
